channel.title: The Global Meridian – International News Wire
channel.description: Authoritative, verified global journalism from international news bureaus across London, Brussels, Washington, Dubai, Moscow, Beijing, Tokyo, Seoul, New Delhi, and Nairobi.

item.title: Quad Leaders Unveil Indo-Pacific Maritime Pact in Manila as Trump Heads to Shenzhen for Xi–Putin Trilateral
item.description: US President Trump joins India’s Narendra Modi, Japan’s Sanae Takaichi, and Australia’s Anthony Albanese in Manila to launch expanded maritime surveillance and cyber frameworks ahead of November 19 talks in Shenzhen.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: Overnight Missile & Drone Strike Collapses 227-Meter Kerch Bridge Span as EU Defense Ministers Convene in Brussels
item.description: A major Ukrainian overnight strike damages the strategic Crimea–Russia Kerch Bridge road arch and adjacent rail line while EU defense ministers gather in Brussels ahead of Berlin postwar security talks.
item.author: j.moreau@meridian-news.org (Julian Moreau)

item.title: South Korea’s Kospi Hits 6-Month Low & Nikkei Drops Ahead of Nvidia Earnings Despite East Asia’s Global Digital Surge
item.description: Samsung, SK Hynix, SoftBank, and Advantest slide in a pre-Nvidia tech correction even as South Korea breaks into the global IMD Digital Top 10, India’s Infosys scales sovereign enterprise AI, and Korea–Africa digital ties expand.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: EU Expands Russia Sanctions Package as German FM Urges Immediate Surge in Gaza Winter Aid
item.description: Brussels widens sanctions against Russian corporate executives tied to Wildberries while German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul presses Israel to permit vital winter humanitarian deliveries into Gaza.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: Leonid Meteor Shower Peaks Tonight Amid Astronomy Warning That 700+ Overhead Satellites Outnumber Visible Stars
item.description: As skywatchers observe the November 17–18 Leonid meteor shower from comet Tempel-Tuttle and NASA marks Voyager 1’s one-light-day milestone, new research finds satellite megaconstellations outnumber stars over mid-latitude cities.
item.author: t.mansoor@meridian-news.org (Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor)

item.title: Global Countdown to ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ Surpasses 15 Million Pre-Orders in Biggest Pop-Culture Launch of 2026
item.description: Thirteen years after GTA V, Rockstar Games’ Grand Theft Auto VI sparks worldwide midnight retail and digital queues across Europe, Asia, and the Americas with pre-orders exceeding 15 million copies.
item.author: j.moreau@meridian-news.org (Julian Moreau)

item.title: US, Japan, South Korea & India Sign ‘San Francisco Declaration’ Under Pax Silica Amid Global Chip Stock Sell-Off
item.description: Washington and nine allied nations sign the November 16 San Francisco Declaration to shield AI infrastructure and critical supply chains as South Korea’s Kospi falls 3.6% and Japan’s Nikkei slides on semiconductor valuation worries.
item.author: m.vance@meridian-news.org (Marcus Vance)

item.title: Estonia Shuts Russia Border Crossings After Foiling Alleged GRU Drone Sabotage Plot as Germany Boosts €139B Defense
item.description: Tallinn accuses Russian military intelligence of targeting local drone maker Threod Systems and orders December 1 border closures, while Berlin expands Airbus A400M airlifter procurement.
item.author: j.moreau@meridian-news.org (Julian Moreau)

item.title: US Deploys Third Carrier to Middle East After Bahrain Drone Strikes as Allies Issue Gaza Winter Aid Ultimatum
item.description: Washington dispatches the USS Theodore Roosevelt amid stalled talks and Iranian drone activity targeting Bahrain, while the UK, Italy, Canada, and Australia demand immediate Gaza shelter access and US envoy Mike Waltz urges Hezbollah disarmament.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: Africa Tech Festival Opens in Cape Town as COP31 Enters Crucial Second Week Over Clean Finance & Critical Minerals
item.description: Telecom and AI leaders from MTN, Vodacom, Naspers, and OpenAI convene in South Africa for digital infrastructure expansion as African and European negotiators clash over fossil-fuel transition language at COP31 in Antalya.
item.author: t.mansoor@meridian-news.org (Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor)

item.title: Finland’s ICEYE Unveils 11cm Gen5 AI Radar Satellites for All-Weather Global Space Monitoring
item.description: Commercial space-radar pioneer ICEYE introduces its fifth-generation Synthetic Aperture Radar platform with 11-centimeter imagery and onboard AI processing for defense, maritime, and disaster response.
item.author: t.mansoor@meridian-news.org (Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor)

item.title: MotoGP Climax in Portimão, Germany–Netherlands Nations League & Jay Shah’s Unanimous ICC Return Lead Global Sports
item.description: Marc Márquez chases an eighth MotoGP title in Portugal as Germany faces the Netherlands in UEFA Nations League action, Africa Cup qualifiers heat up, and Jay Shah secures unanimous re-election at the ICC board meeting in Bali.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: South Korea’s SK Hynix Unveils $1.05B Chip Supplier Hub & Nvidia Reaffirms 260,000 GPUs Amid National Exam AI Audit
item.description: SK Hynix pledges ₩1.4 trillion over five years for domestic wafer-equipment makers and its Yongin Trinity Fab as Nvidia advances 260,000-GPU sovereign AI deployments and Seoul orders security audits after a generative-AI exam cheating confession.
item.author: m.vance@meridian-news.org (Marcus Vance)

item.title: Japan Economy Contracts 0.1% in Q3 as Tokyo Watches ¥160/$ Currency Threshold and Prepares Defense AI Rules
item.description: Cabinet Office figures show unexpected July–September contraction driven by weaker household spending, while Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama warns on yen intervention and Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi readies end-November Defense AI Guidelines.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: Seoul FM Visits Beijing for Peninsula Stability Ahead of APEC as North Korean Aide’s Moscow Trip Draws Scrutiny
item.description: South Korean Foreign Minister Cho Hyun meets China’s Wang Yi to manage Korean Peninsula stability while top North Korean official Jo Yong Won’s visit to Russia raises strategic alarms in Seoul and Tokyo.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: Namdaemun Market’s Viral ‘Scarf Man’ Draws Global Queues in Seoul Amid Northeast Asia Culture & Travel Surge
item.description: A humorous Seoul street merchant urging visitors not to buy from his stall turns Namdaemun Market into a viral stop, mirroring record cultural travel flows linking Tokyo, Kyoto, and Seoul.
item.author: j.moreau@meridian-news.org (Julian Moreau)

item.title: India’s Modi Joins ASEAN & East Asia Summits as New Delhi Expands Trade Corridors from Minsk to Cairo
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi leads India’s delegation to Manila for ASEAN-India, East Asia, and Quad talks while New Delhi advances $1B Belarus trade goals and industrial ties with Egypt.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: China Balances Russia Ties and Europe Trade Ahead of Shenzhen Summit as Middle East Crisis Anchors Talks
item.description: As Beijing hosts the 2026 World Sailing Conference in Qingdao and prepares for November 19 talks with Trump and Putin, European and Middle Eastern envoys scrutinize China’s diplomatic balancing act.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: US Aviation Recovers After Historic FAA Ground Stop as Shenzhen Confirms Nov 19 Trump-Xi-Putin Trilateral
item.description: Air travel across the United States resumes normal schedules following only the second nationwide FAA ground stop since 2001, as diplomats finalize November 19 US-China-Russia summit talks in Shenzhen.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: India Seals Dramatic 22-Run ODI Win in New Zealand as CAF U-23 Africa Cup Qualifiers Peak
item.description: India clinches a thrilling 22-run victory in Mount Maunganui to cap its New Zealand tour as Zambia, Nigeria, and Ghana headline intense second-round U-23 AFCON qualifiers across Africa.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: Brazil-China Trade Jumps 20% Amid US Tariffs as India-Egypt Pact & Canada’s $560M Fund Reshape Commerce
item.description: President Lula spotlights shifting Americas-China trade flows and secures $560M from Canada’s Mark Carney, while India’s Piyush Goyal visits Cairo and Japan posts a 0.1% Q3 contraction.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: AI Coding Security Spotlight: Cursor Third-Party Key Breach and $4B Norwest Fund Fuel "Agentic Cybersecurity"
item.description: A third-party vendor key compromise exposing a trojanized Claude Code extension underscores supply-chain risks as Norwest launches a $4B fund and Cohere names Jaya Baloo as CISO.
item.author: m.vance@meridian-news.org (Marcus Vance)

item.title: ‘Yalta 2.0’ Fears Grip Europe as EU & Kyiv Demand Guarantees Ahead of Shenzhen Trump-Xi-Putin Summit
item.description: European capitals push back against superpower sphere-of-influence deals while Moscow signals openness to a European seat in Ukraine peace talks and battles persist near Kupyansk.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: Tanker Mine Strikes Near Strait of Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb Troop Realignment Escalate Maritime Alert
item.description: Iran’s Revolutionary Guard reports two oil tankers struck mines near the Strait of Hormuz as Yemeni government forces withdraw from Bab el-Mandeb positions to reinforce Aden.
item.author: j.moreau@meridian-news.org (Julian Moreau)

item.title: NASA’s Voyager 1 Nears Historic One Light-Day Milestone 26 Billion Kilometers from Earth
item.description: Nearly 50 years after launch, Voyager 1 approaches a 24-hour radio signal distance from Earth alongside breakthroughs in Caltech autonomous robotic space assembly and MIT-Harvard’s Lumina cosmic simulation.
item.author: t.mansoor@meridian-news.org (Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor)

item.title: Mercedes Clinches 9th F1 Constructors’ Crown as Messi Wins Back-to-Back MLS Golden Boot
item.description: George Russell and Kimi Antonelli seal Mercedes-Benz’s ninth Formula One team title in São Paulo while Lionel Messi sets an MLS record with 26 goals for consecutive Golden Boots.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: World Prematurity Day 2026: WHO Urges Expanded NICU Care for 15 Million Preterm Infants Amid DR Congo Ebola Strain
item.description: On November 15, the World Health Organization calls for stronger neonatal follow-up care globally while UN responders warn conflict is hindering Ebola containment in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
item.author: t.mansoor@meridian-news.org (Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor)

item.title: Orbital Data Centers & MIT AI Climate Emulators Spark Global Tech Policy Debate in Late 2026
item.description: As Innovation for Cool Earth Forum warns space-based compute governance lags behind hardware launches, MIT and Stanford unveil ultra-fast AI models for climate and laser physics.
item.author: m.vance@meridian-news.org (Marcus Vance)

item.title: Sandip Ray Launches Four-Story Satyajit Ray Anthology Shoot as "Godzilla Minus Zero" Surges Worldwide
item.description: Veteran director Sandip Ray adapts iconic classics Khagam, Batik Babu, Bhuto, and Neel Atanka with an all-star Bengali cast while global box-office buzz builds around Godzilla Minus Zero.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: Abu Dhabi Trilateral Talks Open as Europe Demands Seat at Table Over US-Brokered Ukraine Security Proposals
item.description: US envoys open direct talks with Ukrainian and Russian representatives in Abu Dhabi while Kyiv and European capitals push back against proposals threatening post-Cold War borders.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: Africa CDC Sounds Alarm on Six-Month Ebola Crisis as African Ministers Demand Climate & Infrastructure Finance
item.description: Africa CDC warns DRC Ebola cases have crossed 11,200 alongside border vigilance in Kenya and Nigeria, while African environment ministers forge a unified COP31 finance coalition.
item.author: t.mansoor@meridian-news.org (Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor)

item.title: Central Banks Face Dual Macro Shock: Fed and BoE Weigh Sticky Energy Inflation Against AI Capex Boom
item.description: Policymakers at the Federal Reserve, Bank of England, and ECB navigate a rare economic split where volatile oil prices fuel inflation fears while massive AI data-center spending sustains growth.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: Satellite Intelligence Shows Iran Rebuilding Strategic Missile Sites Amid Heightened Western Arms Interdiction
item.description: Commercial orbital imagery analyzed by international defense monitors reveals accelerated reconstruction at Garmdareh, Shahroud, and Parchin alongside stepped-up overland enforcement.
item.author: j.moreau@meridian-news.org (Julian Moreau)

item.title: Spain’s First General Strike in 14 Years Sparks Debate Over Housing Crisis and Snap Election Politics
item.description: Millions join demonstrations over housing affordability and wages in an unusual political mobilization widely analyzed across Europe as a prelude to snap parliamentary elections.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: Analysis: Central Asia Emerges as Vital Eurasian Trade Corridor Amid Supply Chain Fragmentation and Sanctions
item.description: Strategic intelligence reports highlight surging rail, port, and critical-mineral investments across Central Asia as global manufacturers diversify away from single-route chokepoints.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: White House Announces Unprecedented US-China-Russia Trilateral Summit at APEC for Strategic Nuclear Talks
item.description: Washington confirms preparations for a rare three-way leadership meeting between US, Chinese, and Russian presidents on the sidelines of the APEC summit focused on strategic arms stability.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: WMO Warns at COP31 Antalya That 2026 Ranks Among Warmest Years Amid Super El Niño and Record Ocean Heat
item.description: As UN climate talks in Antalya enter week two, the World Meteorological Organization reports record-breaking ocean temperatures, rising sea levels, and urgent EU climate-health action.
item.author: t.mansoor@meridian-news.org (Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor)

item.title: OECD Projects 2.9% Global Economic Growth in 2026 Driven by AI Infrastructure Boom as UK Expands 0.7% in Q3
item.description: Sustained capital expenditures in data centers, power grids, and enterprise AI outpace energy volatility, lifting UK third-quarter output to its fastest pace in over two years.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: Industry Shifts Toward "Physical AI" as Autonomous Robotics and Grid-Scale Compute Capex Surge Worldwide
item.description: Enterprise technology leaders move beyond chat interfaces to deploy agentic software and embodied robotics across semiconductor fabs, logistics ports, and scientific laboratories.
item.author: m.vance@meridian-news.org (Marcus Vance)

item.title: WEF and Frontiers Spotlight Direct Lithium Extraction, Grid-Interactive EVs, and Personalized mRNA Cancer Vaccines
item.description: Joint international scientific assessment highlights three breakthrough technologies moving from laboratory prototypes to commercial global scale in 2026.
item.author: t.mansoor@meridian-news.org (Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor)

item.title: Strait of Hormuz Maritime Security Alerts Intensify as Global Allies Review Strategic Defense Posture and Satellite Resilience
item.description: Heightened naval monitoring across Middle Eastern shipping lanes coincides with accelerated multi-year defense modernization plans and orbital reconnaissance deployments.
item.author: j.moreau@meridian-news.org (Julian Moreau)

item.title: SAFF Championship: Defending Champions India Edge Bhutan 2-1 to Reach Regional Football Final
item.description: A spirited second-half performance seals India's berth in the South Asian Football Federation championship decider after a fiercely contested semifinal.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: International Film Festival of India Sets 159 Global Films Under "Stories Without Borders" Theme Ahead of Goa Opening
item.description: The 57th IFFI opens Nov 20 with Paweł Pawlikowski's Cannes-winning "Fatherland" alongside 159 international selections chosen from over 1,400 global submissions.
